_doc: 藥物頁人工查核紀錄（單一真實來源；2026-11-12 建，核心流程比照 TwTxGNN docs/_data/drug_reviews.json，欄位相同）。每筆＝一次查核：drug／file／claim（頁面原句）／replacement（更正後）／note（頁面上顯示的本站語言說明）／finding（內部查證結論）／sources（網址＋查閱日）／checked（查核日）／action（correct 更正｜annotate 加註｜rereview 待重審｜section 附來源段落｜rereview_result 重審結果｜header_level｜description_level）。由 scripts/apply_drug_reviews.py 套到 docs/_drugs/*.md；改寫頁面的程式結尾都會重套，scripts/check_seo_docs.py 第 17 項擋未套用的紀錄。原則：基本事實照主管機關資料更正；模型預測原文不刪不改寫，只加註；證據等級與決策只在重審結果為降級、升級或撤回時更新。2026-10-31、11-05～06 依成分重建許可證後直接刪掉的矛盾子句，2026-11-12 由 scripts/reviews_from_edits.py 依 git 前後版本轉入（id 以 <站碼>-lic- 開頭）；報告在 11 月經 AI 重產、原句已不在頁面的標 status=resolved_by_regeneration。同 id 重發時前版存進 history（retired、reason），不覆蓋丟棄。

records.anchor:
- **Malignant renovascular hypertension** (score 0.9928, L4): The mechanistic rationale is strong because the condition is renin-dependent. One 1984 clinical report describes captopril in stable and malignant hypertension ([PMID 6145432](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/6145432/)). The rest of the literature is mostly case reports, reviews and diagnostic papers. One case report ([PMID 6321850](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/6321850/)) described acute, reversible renal failure after captopril and enalapril in a patient with bilateral renal artery occlusion. This is the most plausible research question of the group, but study types were classified from titles only and are tentative.
- **Pulmonary hypertension owing to lung disease and/or hypoxia** (score 0.9915, L5): Only preclinical and indirect findings were retrieved, and most of the retrieved papers appear unrelated. Systemic vasodilators can also worsen ventilation-perfusion matching in hypoxic lung disease.
- **Pulmonary hypertension with unclear multifactorial mechanism** (score 0.9915, L5): No trials or literature. ACE inhibitors are not an established therapy for pulmonary arterial hypertension.

- **Drug Interactions**: 100 interactions were recorded. Examples at moderate level include acetylsalicylic acid, corticosteroids (hydrocortisone, dexamethasone, betamethasone, budesonide, triamcinolone), metformin, chlorpropamide, mesalazine, balsalazide and aprepitant. Minor-level examples include famotidine, ranitidine and cimetidine.
- **Literature safety signals**: enteropathy with villous atrophy after prolonged use, and the risk of medication-overuse headache with frequent analgesic use. One report links analgesic use, including mefenamic acid, with chronic renal disease in patients with headache.
